memory_capacity.reason: Memory capacity in the sense of Jaeger (2001) requires driving the reservoir with a temporally extended input stream and training readouts to reconstruct u(t-k) from the reservoir state. This dataset contains one independent Gaussian pulse response per scan location, with no sequential excitation, so MC is not identifiable. idea.md anticipated exactly this restriction.
memory_capacity.do_not_substitute: The lagged autocorrelation of a scan-averaged waveform is NOT memory capacity; it measures smoothness and any low-pass signal scores highly on it.

defect_depth_and_volume.reason: The project's own sources disagree on the ground-truth depths (dataset_loader.py lists 0.86/0.66/0.48... mm; the previous manuscript Table 2B lists 1/2/3 mm). Without a documented depth reference, depth and volume regression cannot be evaluated honestly.

physical_size_calibration.reason: The pixel-to-millimetre scale (1 px = 1 mm) is implied by the project's own claim that r=5 px corresponds to d=10 mm, but is not independently documented. All millimetre statements inherit this assumption.

inference_time.note: See timing.json; measured with a timer, reported per scan point.
